title: Omukago Ogwayita Okuzikirizibwa
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’okuumibwa wansi w’akasolya kamu n’okubikkulirwa, naye ng’olonda obwesigwa obw’enjawulo. Omuntu ono yabeeranga kumpi nnyo n’amazima n’obunnabbi, naye n’akyuka n’atunuulira abo abaali babigaana. Emboozi yaabwe eyimiridde ng’okulabula okw’ekitiibwa nti okumpi n’obutuukirivu kwokka tekuyinza kutaasa mwoyo ogulyamu obwesige olukwe.
clues: Nabeeranga mu maka ga nabbi Allah gwe yalonda.
Nnali mmanyi amazima omwami wange ge yali abuulira, naye nga sigakkiriza mu mazima.
Nalyamu obwesige olukwe nga ndi ku ludda lw’okugaana abantu ne mbayambako okumulwanyisa.
Njogerwako wamu ne munne wa nabbi omulala naye eyalyamu olukwe, ng’ekyokulabirako eri abatakkiriza.
Emboozi yange eyogerwa mu Surah At-Tahrim ng’okulabula nti obuzaale ne bannabbi tebuwa bukuumi bwonna.
Nazikirira wamu n’abasobya Allah bwe yasaanyaawo abantu ba Luti, ne balekawo n’abo abaasigalawo.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Yalyamu nabbi olukwe nga ayamba abatakkiriza okumulwanyisa
Suula omwana omuwere mu mugga mu kibbo okumutaasa
Yasaba ennyana eya zaabu zizimbibwe mu kiseera nnabbi nga taliiwo
Yalumiriza omuweereza omutuukirivu okukola ebibi n’amusiba
trial.answer: Yalyamu nabbi olukwe nga ayamba abatakkiriza okumulwanyisa

location.label: Ekintu Ekikulu

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yazikirizibwa n’abatakkiriza wadde nga yafumbirwa nabbi
Yalokoka n’abakkiriza n’ayingira ejjana mu mirembe
Yafuulibwa empagi ng’akabonero eri emirembe egyaddirira
outcome.answer: Yazikirizibwa n’abatakkiriza wadde nga yafumbirwa nabbi

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
